findings.text: `requirements.md` does not exist in the task folder (only `past-work.md`, `session.jsonl`, `review/diff.patch`), and `session.jsonl` holds just the assign line and a commit id: "does it do what the owner asked" cannot be checked, and a fresh agent could not continue from this folder. Write the owner's ask (the scroll-lock and pin-to-bottom words) and an outcome into the task folder.

The task title says the fix touches `Chat.js`, `Chat.css` and `ux/D…`, but `review/diff.patch` holds only `ext/Chat/doc/scroll.md`, `ux/Dictate/Widget.js` and `ux/Dictate/doc/voice-assistant.md`. The code that `scroll.md` describes (gesture-gated unlock within 1 s, 40px lock zone, `elementsFromPoint` tail padding, MutationObserver re-pin) is not in the diff; I confirmed only that `Widget.PIN_BOTTOM` exists (`Widget.js:136,264`). Rebuild the diff against the right base so it covers all of the work.

`ux/Dictate/doc/voice-assistant.md:60` ("Nothing jumps") is stale and now contradicts itself. The new "Changed 2026-10-25" paragraph was glued onto the old one, so the section still says "Rejected: pinning the newest line to the bottom", which is the new default. Move the old page-turn text into a clearly labelled `PIN_BOTTOM = false` subsection and drop or reword the "Rejected" sentence.

`Widget.js:249` adds a MutationObserver on the thread that calls `anchor()` in both modes. In `PIN_BOTTOM = false` mode this fires on every mutation, and the doc claims "Words growing inside a bubble never scroll the box". Either gate the observer on `PIN_BOTTOM`, or state that it is harmless there because `anchor()` only schedules a frame.

The `PIN_BOTTOM` toggle keeps two behaviours alive, and `test/anchor.mjs` proves only the non-default one (`voice-assistant.md:60`). Add a test for the default, or delete the old mode if nobody wants it. That would be the simpler option.
`scroll.md:12` says the lock zone is 40px, up from 4px. Check that `Chat/readme.md` and other docs that say "within 4px" were updated (not visible in this diff).
No page was changed, so I answered no Layout, Colour or Sizing checks, and there are no shots.

`ux/Dictate/readme.md` (line 30) still lists `test/anchor.mjs` as a proof, and `ux/Dictate/test/files.jsonl` line 5 still declares `anchor.mjs` (line 33 marks it gone). The file was deleted, so the readme names a test that no longer exists; remove the readme mention and the stale files.jsonl entry.

`ux/Dictate/test/chat-sent.mjs` (lines 1-4, 64-67) still asserts the "fast ✓ / smart ✓" badge text. Ask 5 hides those marks with `display: none` (`Chat.css:604`), so the test's docs and intent are stale. Update it to check that the marks are hidden, or drop that check.

The diff has no new proof. Ask 1-4 and 6 rest on "headless probe" results, but no probe script is in the task folder or the repo, and `anchor.mjs` (the only scroll proof for the V1 sheet) was deleted. A fresh agent cannot re-run the proof; commit a small `test/pin.mjs` (or extend `chat-sent.mjs`) that checks pinned-through-growth, unlock on wheel-up, the newest button above a fixed bar, and `scrollWidth <= clientWidth`.

The diff covers only the last commit of the series. The gesture gate, 40px zone, `overlap()` and the `display: none` CSS (asks 2, 3, 5) are not in `diff.patch`. I confirmed them in the worktree (`Chat.js:333-378`, `Chat.css:604`), but the review diff should span the whole branch.

`Widget.Thread.anchor()` and `sticky_scroll` each run a rAF-throttled MutationObserver on the same box. They do the same job for the two callers (`observe: false` versus `true`), so they are not duplicated for one caller. That is acceptable, but the pin logic exists in two places (Law 6).
`ux/Dictate/test/earlier.mjs` ("show earlier" moves the reader) is a known failure that predates this task. It is queued in `ai/todo.md`, so I raise nothing further.

The `voice-assistant.md#nothing-jumps` paragraph is accurate for the new design and `ext/Chat/doc/scroll.md` is updated. The `ext/Chat/readme.md` pointer to scroll.md is intact, so I found no other doc drift.
